title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：profile　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 profile 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the foreman ① drew the profile that no worker in the site would have recorded, and he said the drawing was the whole of the shift. The ② profile, meaning the outline itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; a profile, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ profile in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ profile at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A profile, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the foreman said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the profile was the whole of the matter, meaning the image and not the outline. The ⑥ profile, meaning the image and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; profile, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both an outline and an image. He said the image is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ profile had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ profile of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of recording; profile, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ profile I remember is the outline recorded in the sheet, which closed in 1988 and is still recorded as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ profile, my mother said in 1990, is the only outline that improves by being recorded; every profile, she said, is an image that has agreed to look like an outline. She said the image was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 轮廓；简介（指工地里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 轮廓；简介（指那个轮廓本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw the profile 勾勒这一个轮廓
D. n. 轮廓；简介（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 轮廓之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的轮廓之事）
F. n. 轮廓；简介（指施工单里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 轮廓、形象（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 形象（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: drew the profile that no worker in the site would have recorded

answers.why: draw the profile 意为“勾勒这一个轮廓”，1981 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯记载的一个轮廓做了一遍。
profile 意为“轮廓；简介”，指那个轮廓本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记载。
profile 意为“轮廓；简介”，指工地里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
profile 意为“轮廓；简介”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
profile 意为“轮廓、形象”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个形象就是那件事的全部。
profile 意为“形象”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个轮廓，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
profile 意为“轮廓；简介”，指施工单里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1986 年这一个成了施工单里的一行。
profile 意为“轮廓之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的轮廓之事是一处工地和三个班次的记载。
profile 意为“轮廓；简介”，我记得的是施工单里记载过的那一个，1988 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一个。
profile 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，轮廓是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的轮廓。
